quality_gate.minimum_bar: New character hero art must read at least as polished as Sodeungsa: crisp emotional face and eyes, functional weapon/prop contact, matte painterly gouache texture, strong silhouette, controlled detail hierarchy, and no generic AI gloss.
must_have: face and eyes are the sharpest area and survive a 256px face crop
class prop or weapon is functional and physically held, not decorative noise
silhouette reads in a 360x520 card crop
matte textured gouache with visible brushwork and canvas grain
single dominant key light with navy or plum shadow temperature
detail hierarchy: face, hands, and signature prop sharp; large clothing areas quieter
lost-and-found edges and varied line weight
character-specific palette and faction marks preserved from game_state.gd
not a copy of Sodeungsa's palette, weapon, pose, outfit, or face
reject_if: glossy 3D render, clean CG, plastic skin, or airbrushed finish
dead symmetrical eyes or face lower quality than Sodeungsa
generic centered full-body with no camera intent
uniform detail everywhere with no rest area
random greebles, unreadable badges, fake letters, or impossible straps
weapon or prop floats, clips, or is held incorrectly
neon/saturated palette that breaks the funeral fantasy tone
looks like a pasted concept mockup rather than production card art

hero.purpose: card, recruitment, dossier, and marketing source art
hero.composition: portrait hero cut with intentional off-center balance; background allowed if it supports the character

card_cutout.composition: transparent-background or cleanly removable character cutout derived from approved hero

face.composition: square face crop derived from approved hero; eyes must remain crisp at 128px

workflow: use Sodeungsa anchor as style and quality reference only
generate 3 to 4 hero candidates for one character at a time
reject candidates below the quality_gate before any sprite or cutout work
derive card_cutout and face only from the approved hero image
connect art/card_art in game_state.gd only after hero, card_cutout, and face all pass review
start or continue PixelLab combat sprites after the hero illustration is locked
prompt_style_lock_en: matte textured gouache, visible brushstrokes and canvas grain, muted desaturated colors, gritty hand-painted; NOT glossy, NOT shiny, NOT clean CG, NOT 3D render, NOT neon, NOT bright glowing. Face and eyes rendered crisp and clean, sharper than the rest; body and background remain painterly. One cool key light from upper left, weak fill only, rich navy and plum shadows, varied line weight, lost-and-found edges, quiet negative space. Detail hierarchy: face, hands, and signature prop sharpest; large clothing areas simplified with drybrush texture. Do not copy the reference character, palette, pose, outfit, weapon, or face; use only the painterly quality.

characters.name: 소등사
characters.brief_ko: 어번 다크레드 머리, 장거리 소총, 낮은 숨, 멜랑콜리한 눈. 이 품질을 캐스트 전체의 하한선으로 둔다.

characters.name: 진혼병
characters.signature_palette: soot black, burnt orange, dark ember
characters.brief_ko: 그을린 장송 코트, 번트오렌지 완장, 짧은 검은 머리, 팔뚝에 관 끈을 감은 근접 선봉.
characters.prompt_core_en: A young frontline funeral striker named Yuhyeon, short black hair, scorched black burial coat, burnt-orange armband, coffin straps wrapped around the forearm, compact melee vanguard silhouette, worn boots, quiet exhausted resolve, no rifle, no shield.

candidate_review.notes: User approved the overall direction. Sheet is strong on matte funeral-fantasy mood, male sharp eyes, black coat, burnt-orange armband, and forearm strap silhouette. Treat as review reference, not final connected art.
candidate_review.recommended_next: Pick the strongest quadrant as composition seed, then generate a single 1024x1536+ hero keyvisual before deriving card_cutout and face.

hero_review.notes: User approved as exact direction. Strong silhouette, sharp male expression, matte funeral-fantasy brushwork, burnt-orange armband, and readable forearm strap/short blade contact. Keep as source hero for downstream card_cutout and face derivation.
hero_review.next: derive card_cutout and face from hero_asset, then connect art/card_art in game_state.gd

characters.name: 집전 의무관
characters.signature_palette: bone white, sage mint, dim oil amber
characters.brief_ko: 본화이트 의무복, 세이지민트 숄, 작은 등유 성물, 피 묻은 장갑. 살리지 못해도 혼자 꺼지게 두지 않는 표정.
characters.prompt_core_en: A field medic officiant named Han Sera, bone-white medical robe, sage-mint shawl, small oil-lamp reliquary, blood-marked gloves, gentle but alert eyes, holding the reliquary with care, healer silhouette, no gun.

characters.name: 운구 소총수
characters.brief_ko: 무광 올리브 운구복, 긴 소총, 관 손잡이를 닮은 슬링, 낮은 모자챙, 피로한 눈.
characters.prompt_core_en: A quiet coffin-bearer rifleman named Baek Ihyeon, matte olive funeral transport uniform, long rifle with coffin-handle sling, low cap brim, tired eyes lowered like closing a coffin lid, practical ammunition pouches, restrained posture.

candidate_review.notes: User approved the coffin-bearer rifleman direction. Strong matte olive funeral transport coat, low cap brim, long rifle, coffin-handle hardware, and tired undertaker posture. Top-right/bottom-right silhouettes are the identity basis.
candidate_review.recommended_next: Use the final hero as PixelLab reference, then derive card/face art after runtime sprite approval.

hero_review.notes: High-quality full-body hero. Readable long rifle, coffin backboard/handle hardware, low cap brim, tired pale expression, matte olive-black funeral coat. Use as source hero for PixelLab combat sprite reference.

characters.name: 사열 돌격수
characters.signature_palette: ash gray, burnt red cord, dull brass
characters.brief_ko: 재색 장교 코트, 짧은 창검, 기울어진 깃발, 흐트러지지 않는 행렬감.
characters.prompt_core_en: A parade assault officer named Ryudan, ash-gray officer coat, short spear-sword, tilted funeral parade banner, burnt-red ornamental cord, disciplined forward pressure, rows and procession implied in the costume design, no modern rifle.

characters.name: 납골 방패병
characters.signature_palette: bone white, slate metal, pale blue-gray
characters.brief_ko: 방패 안쪽의 이름표들, 슬레이트 금속, 느린 성채 같은 자세. 든 이름들이 무거운 사람.

characters.name: 망종 중계사
characters.signature_palette: sage green, mustard amber, dull cable black
characters.brief_ko: 낡은 리시버, 작은 종 안테나, 잡음 속 목소리를 찾는 표정.
characters.prompt_core_en: A bell-relay operator named Cha Miru, old receiver, small bell-shaped antenna, relay backpack, sage and mustard cables, listening for a distant rescue signal through static, one hand near the earpiece, slightly delayed but intent expression.

characters.name: 관지기
characters.brief_ko: 실버 머리, 슬레이트블루 장갑, 코어 결정 방패, 넓은 어깨와 낮은 자세. 소등사 기준으로 재평가 후 유지/리터치 결정.
